_doc: Strategic-sites reference layer (RAW). ALL 16 coordinates imagery-verified 2026-07-03 (DESIGN.md REFERENCE DATA ACCURACY rule; scripts/site_verify.py renders each coordinate on Esri World Imagery with a crosshair — facility must be visibly present). Positions are on-facility, good to ~100-300m. Each entry lists why it matters to a tradable exposure. Served via /api/data/sites.

sites.name: Cushing Oil Hub (WTI delivery point)
sites.relevance: WTI futures physical delivery point; ~10% of US crude storage. Tank-shadow fill estimates here are the Sentinel-2 SIGNAL candidate (vs EIA weekly ground truth). Exposure: USO, XLE, CL futures.
sites.note: Marker centered on the main tank district S of town (imagery-verified on tanks); individual terminals ring the town.

sites.name: Enbridge Cushing Terminal
sites.relevance: Largest single Cushing operator (~20M bbl shell capacity).

sites.name: Steel Dynamics — Butler Flat Roll
sites.relevance: STLD's original flat-roll mill. Yard inventory change detection is a future SIGNAL candidate (capacity-constrained mid-cap angle).
sites.note: Butler, Indiana — imagery-verified on the mill complex SW of town (old pin was farmland ~7km NE).

sites.name: Steel Dynamics — Columbus Flat Roll
sites.note: Golden Triangle megasite adjacent to GTR airport, W of Columbus MS — imagery-verified on the mill (old pin was ~18km E in Columbus suburbs).

sites.name: Steel Dynamics — Sinton Flat Roll
sites.relevance: Newest EAF flat-roll mill (2022 ramp); its utilization is a live earnings variable.
sites.note: Sinton, Texas — imagery-verified on the mill NE of town (old pin was ranch land ~11km W).

sites.name: Steel Dynamics — Structural & Rail
sites.relevance: Structural steel + rail; nonresidential construction proxy.
sites.note: E of Columbia City, Indiana — imagery-verified on the structural mill (old pin was downtown ~12km W).

sites.name: Port of Los Angeles
sites.relevance: #1 US container port. Ship-queue counts (AIS) here were the classic 2021 supply-chain signal. Exposure: retail (XRT), logistics (IYT).

sites.name: Port of Long Beach
sites.relevance: #2 US container port; shares San Pedro Bay anchorage with POLA.
sites.note: Pier J container terminal — imagery-verified (old pin was in the channel).

sites.name: Port of Houston (Barbours Cut)
sites.note: Barbours Cut Container Terminal, Morgan's Point — imagery-verified on the yard (old pin was open water in Trinity Bay ~6km E).

sites.name: Port of Oakland
sites.note: Oakland International Container Terminal berths — imagery-verified (old pin was Jack London Square waterfront).

sites.name: Port of Seattle
sites.note: Terminal 18, Harbor Island — imagery-verified on the container yard (old pin was the island's fuel tank farm).

sites.name: Port of Charleston (Wando Welch)
sites.note: Wando Welch Terminal, Mount Pleasant — imagery-verified on the container yards (old pin was ~10km N in residential Mount Pleasant).
